evidence.quote: Introductory pricing is $2.00 per million input tokens and $10.00 per million output tokens, with a 95% discount on cached input. After the introductory period those rates double to $4.00 and $20.00 per million tokens. None of it appears on the public pricing page yet.

: at $10 per million output tokens, a single 100K-token generated artifact costs about a dollar during the introductory period and about two dollars afterward. That is the arithmetic that makes the 1M output budget interesting and also the arithmetic that makes it expensive — a full 1M-token generation is roughly $10 at the promotional rate and $20 at the standard rate, before any input cost.

First, no first-party source checked for this article defines the exact semantics of the 1M ceiling — whether streaming, multi-turn continuation, or per-attempt accounting applies. Second, Google has not published a rate limit, latency, or time-to-first-token figure alongside the limit. Third, because Argon has no model ID in the public API documentation as of September 30, there is currently no way for an outside developer to test the claim directly.

Gemini 4 Argon 采用按量计费模式,整体定价远低于同级竞品,性价比优势显著:输入Token单价为2美元/百万Token,输出Token单价为10美元/百万Token,缓存输入可享受95%折扣,大幅降低企业与开发者的高频调用成本,整体费用仅为Claude Opus 5.5的1/2左右。

大规模调用成本偏高
:虽单价亲民,但百万Token级高频调用,整体成本仍高于轻量化模型。

claims.statement: 第三方指南记载，Gemini 4 Argon 的推介期定价为每百万输入 Token 2.00 美元、每百万输出 Token 10.00 美元，缓存输入享 95% 折扣；推介期结束后费率翻倍至每百万输入 4.00 美元、每百万输出 20.00 美元，且这些价格尚未出现在公开定价页面上。

claims.statement: 第三方指南按每百万输出 Token 10 美元推算，单次生成 10 万 Token 的产物在推介期约花费 1 美元、推介期后约 2 美元；一次完整的 100 万 Token 生成在推介价下约 10 美元、标准价下约 20 美元，且不含任何输入成本。

claims.statement: 第三方指南指出，截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，没有任何第一方来源定义 100 万 Token 输出上限的确切语义（流式、多轮续写或按次计费），谷歌也未公布配套的速率限制、延迟或首 Token 时间数据，且 Argon 在公开 API 文档中没有模型 ID，外部开发者无法直接测试该能力。
